svg.text: Literals are Huffman coded on their own; the sequences become one FSE bitstream with three interleaved states.

svg.text: LL, ML and OF each have an FSE
The 4 literal streams decode in parallel; the sequence bitstream is decoded one sequence at a time, from its end.
